content.title: You Were Never Told the Real Purpose of Education
content.text: What is the purpose of education? What is the purpose of school? I really hope this video inspires you to think about one of the most essential questions of society and to craft your own opinion, especially in the age of AI where education is in a crisis. Is school meant to just teach you basic numeracy, reading and writing skills? Or should it do more? Should it develop us as humans? I'm so here for the value of play, creativity, fostering IMAGINATION, critical thinking, entrepreneurial spirit, artistic expression and introspection! And we can design school in a way that it does it all... without the stress and burnout.
